# Escape the Matrix

**Time Limit:** `1000 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `256 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/escape-the-matrix/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/escape-the-matrix/)  

---

You are given a matrix $T$ of dimensions $H \times W$. Each element of the matrix will contain one of the four characters $U, R, D, L$. If at any point you are located in cell $(i, j)$, $T_{i,j}$ will determine where you move next.

$T_{i,j} = U$ you will move to cell $(i - 1, j)$ $T_{i,j} = R$ you will move to cell $(i, j + 1)$ $T_{i,j} = D$ you will move to cell $(i + 1, j)$ $T_{i,j} = L$ you will move to cell $(i, j - 1)$ 

Your task is to find out for how many cells, if you start the journey from there, you will eventually escape the matrix.

### Standard input

The first line contains two integers $H$ and $W$.

Each of the next $H$ lines contains $W$ characters from the set $U, R, D, L$.

### Standard output

The first line should contain the answer for the problem.

### Constraints and notes

$3 \leq H \leq 500$ $3 \leq W \leq 500$ each cell of the matrix will a character from the set $\{U, R, D, L\}$
